Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

Your Impact

As Senior Director, Finance Systems within OpenText’s CDO organization, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how technology enables Finance at a global scale. This is a highly visible leadership role where you’ll lead functional and technical teams responsible for Finance systems delivery, operations, and modernization, including SAP on-premises applications and integrated services.

You’ll help drive OpenText’s Finance modernization agenda, including the implementation of S/4HANA Cloud, while partnering with senior Finance and IT leaders to turn business priorities into technology outcomes. You’ll lead through complexity, leverage AI and emerging technologies, and deliver measurable value for Finance teams and business users globally.

Leading effectively in a global operating model, with teams distributed across geographies and organizational structures.
Communicating complex technical and business concepts clearly and effectively to leadership and diverse audiences.
Thinking strategically and critically, developing roadmaps, and translating strategy into execution.
Managing multiple priorities, plans, and budgets in a fast-paced environment while delivering on time and on budget.
Driving best practices, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and a culture of learning across teams.
Building and motivating high-performing teams and fostering an environment of trust, collaboration, and accountability.

10+ years of experience leading engineering, development, or technology delivery teams.
Strong experience leading complex SAP ERP delivery and operations, including SAP on-premises platforms and integrated Finance systems.
Proven experience leading S/4HANA Cloud implementations, including program delivery, business process transformation, stakeholder alignment, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization.
Strong understanding of complementary financial systems and cross-domain technology ecosystems, including Finance, HR, and CRM.
Experience supporting technology integrations related to Mergers, Acquisitions, and Divestitures (M&A).
Experience leading multiple complex workstreams within a global organization.

jobs.description:
À PROPOS DE POWER FACTORS

Power Factors est un fournisseur de logiciels et de solutions qui ouvre la voie à la prochaine génération d'énergie propre grâce à Unity, l'une des suites de gestion d'énergie renouvelable (REMS) les plus complètes et les plus largement déployées sur le marché. Avec plus de 300 GW d'actifs éoliens, solaires et de stockage d'énergie gérés dans le monde entier auprès de plus de 600 clients et 18 000 sites, Power Factors gère 25 % des données mondiales sur les énergies renouvelables.*

La suite Unity REMS de Power Factors soutient l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur énergétique, de la surveillance et du contrôle à l'analyse des marchés. L'ensemble d'applications ouvertes et axées sur les données de l'entreprise permet aux parties prenantes du secteur des énergies renouvelables de collaborer, d'automatiser les flux de travail critiques et de prendre des décisions plus éclairées afin de maximiser les rendements des actifs. Les parties prenantes bénéficient d'un soutien de bout en bout, incluant des solutions pour le SCADA et le PPC, la surveillance centralisée, la gestion de la performance, la gestion commerciale des actifs et la gestion des services sur le terrain.

Grâce à une expertise approfondie du domaine, des perspectives propulsées par l'IA sont livrées à grande échelle, permettant aux entreprises d'optimiser leurs actifs, de stimuler leur croissance et de prendre des décisions plus éclairées dans un contexte de transition rapide vers l'énergie propre. Power Factors lutte contre les changements climatiques grâce au code.

Hors Chine et Inde

À PROPOS DU POSTE

Power Factors prend de l'ampleur en termes de complexité — davantage de produits, de plateformes, d'acheteurs sophistiqués, et des attentes croissantes quant aux capacités natives en IA dans notre suite de logiciels pour les énergies renouvelables. Dans ce contexte, l'absence d'une vision technique unique et imputable crée un risque réel : des schémas architecturaux divergents selon les secteurs verticaux, des approches incohérentes en matière d'investissement dans les plateformes d'IA et de données, et une dette technique qui s'accumule plus vite qu'elle ne peut être résorbée.

Le rôle de Responsable de l'architecture logicielle existe pour combler cet écart. Il s'agit d'un poste de leadership technique pratique et hautement spécialisé, chargé de définir et d'appliquer les normes d'architecture d'entreprise à l'échelle de l'organisation Produits et Technologie de Power Factors — couvrant les secteurs Plateforme, SCADA, EMS, APM, CloudOps et CAM/FSM/Ops produit — tout en concevant et en prototypant personnellement les problèmes les plus complexes auxquels l'organisation est confrontée, notamment en matière d'introduction de produits basés sur l'IA, d'acquisition de données IoT et d'évolutivité SaaS multitenant.

Ce poste combine la portée stratégique d'un·e architecte d'entreprise et la crédibilité d'un·e bâtisseur·se qui continue d'écrire du code, de réviser des demandes de tirage (pull requests) et d'être à l'aise en tant que personne la plus technique dans la salle.

Relevant directement du ou de la Chef·fe des produits et de la technologie (CPTO), la personne titulaire agit comme tissu connectif entre la stratégie organisationnelle du ou de la CPTO et les décisions techniques quotidiennes prises par les équipes d'ingénierie verticales, en collaborant étroitement avec les responsables des secteurs (Plateforme, SCADA, EMS, APM, CloudOps, CAM/FSM/Ops produit), la gestion de produit et les équipes CloudOps et Sécurité.

Il est important de noter que ce rôle n'est pas un poste purement stratégique ou consultatif éloigné du code, ni un rôle de gestion axé sur les processus et les rapports. La personne titulaire est appelée à demeurer une contributrice technique crédible et active tout au long de son mandat. Ce poste ne comprend pas non plus la responsabilité de la priorisation de la feuille de route produit ou de la stratégie commerciale — ces responsabilités demeurent avec la gestion de produit et le ou la CPTO — mais il façonne directement ce qui est techniquement possible et à quelle vitesse cela peut être livré.

CE QUE VOUS FEREZ

Architecture d'entreprise et conception de systèmes complexes

Définir et maintenir les normes d'architecture d'entreprise, les architectures de référence et les garde-fous techniques de Power Factors pour l'ensemble des secteurs verticaux
Diriger les revues architecturales pour les initiatives majeures, en assurant la cohérence, l'évolutivité et la maintenabilité à long terme
Être responsable de la feuille de route technique pour les capacités de plateforme transversales (plateforme de données, couche d'intégration, identité, observabilité)
Concevoir des systèmes complexes à haute disponibilité où l'exactitude, la latence et l'intégrité des données ont des conséquences opérationnelles et commerciales réelles
Collaborer avec les responsables des secteurs verticaux (SCADA, EMS, APM, Plateforme, CloudOps) pour s'assurer que les décisions architecturales locales s'alignent sur la direction d'entreprise

Leadership technique des équipes

Bâtir et diriger une fonction d'architecture distribuée opérant comme une autorité technique de confiance en Grèce, à Montréal et dans d'autres régions
Encadrer les ingénieur·e·s senior et les responsables en ingénierie en matière de jugement architectural, de conception de systèmes et d'analyse des compromis techniques
Établir et animer des forums de gouvernance architecturale (revues de conception, processus RFC, comités de pilotage technique)
Agir comme point d'escalade technique pour les décisions de conception les plus critiques de l'organisation

Architecture et livraison de produits basés sur l'IA

Concevoir et contribuer personnellement à la construction de capacités de produits basées sur l'IA de bout en bout — de l'acquisition de données et de la sélection de modèles jusqu'au déploiement et à la surveillance
Définir l'approche architecturale de Power Factors pour les produits basés sur les LLM, incluant l'utilisation du Model Context Protocol (MCP), les architectures de récupération et les flux de travail agentiques
Évaluer et sélectionner les LLM de développement et les plateformes d'IA adaptés à l'intégration dans des produits commerciaux
Assurer le pont technique entre REMI et les autres initiatives natives en IA et l'architecture de plateforme globale
Mettre à profit l'expertise en apprentissage automatique et en science des données pour orienter les décisions produit — sélection de modèles, ingénierie des caractéristiques, conception de pipelines de données et pratiques MLOps

Développement pratique

Écrire du code de production, prototyper de nouveaux schémas architecturaux et contribuer directement aux problèmes techniques les plus complexes de l'organisation
Montrer l'exemple en matière de qualité du code, de discipline de test et d'excellence en ingénierie
Rester suffisamment proche du code pour formuler des jugements architecturaux crédibles et actuels, plutôt que de se fier à des rapports de seconde main
Réaliser des implémentations de validation de concept pour réduire les risques liés aux grands paris architecturaux avant l'engagement complet des équipes

Architecture IoT, périphérie et systèmes industriels

Concevoir des systèmes d'acquisition de données IoT évolutifs capables d'ingérer, de normaliser et de traiter des volumes élevés de télémétrie provenant d'actifs d'énergie renouvelable distribués
Définir l'architecture pour les dispositifs de périphérie et les contrôleurs de centrale (PPC), en équilibrant le calcul sur site, les contraintes de latence et la connectivité infonuagique
S'assurer que les approches architecturales tiennent compte de la conformité aux codes du réseau, des exigences de contrôle en temps réel et des réalités opérationnelles des environnements SCADA et EMS
Appliquer la connaissance du domaine des énergies renouvelables et de l'énergie pour orienter les décisions de modélisation des données, d'intégration et de conception des systèmes de contrôle

Architecture infonuagique, SaaS et multitenant

Être responsable de la stratégie d'architecture infonuagique sur GCP et/ou AWS, incluant les postures de coût, de résilience et de sécurité
Faire progresser l'architecture SaaS multitenant de Power Factors pour prendre en charge l'échelle, l'isolation des locataires et la configurabilité sans fragmenter le code
Définir les normes architecturales pour le développement d'applications mobiles là où les produits s'étendent aux cas d'utilisation sur le terrain et en opérations
Évaluer les décisions de construction ou d'achat et de consolidation de plateformes à travers la pile technologique

Productivité de l'ingénierie et développement assisté par l'IA

Identifier, évaluer et déployer des outils de développement IA qui permettent une amélioration de la productivité de 3 à 4 fois au sein des équipes d'ingénierie
Définir les meilleures pratiques pour la programmation, les tests et la revue de code assistés par l'IA, en équilibrant vitesse, qualité et sécurité
Collaborer avec la direction de l'ingénierie pour mesurer et communiquer les gains de productivité issus de l'adoption des outils d'IA

Indicateurs de succès

Nombre de capacités de produits basées sur l'IA conçues et mises en production par année
Gains de productivité mesurés (vélocité, délai de cycle) attribuables au déploiement des outils de développement IA
Réduction des incohérences architecturales entre secteurs verticaux et des investissements de plateforme dupliqués
Métriques de fiabilité et de performance des systèmes critiques d'entreprise et transactionnels
Taux d'adoption des normes architecturales et des conceptions de référence à travers les équipes d'ingénierie
Rétroaction qualitative à 360° des responsables en ingénierie sur l'efficacité du leadership technique

CE QUE VOUS DEVEZ APPORTER

15 à 20 ans d'expérience progressive en génie logiciel, avec une part importante consacrée à l'architecture et aux rôles de leadership technique
Expérience démontrée dans la conception de systèmes à grande échelle et haute complexité avec des enjeux opérationnels importants
Capacité avérée à diriger et à encadrer des ingénieur·e·s et des architectes senior au sein d'équipes distribuées
Expérience dans la conception de systèmes transactionnels ou de trading à haut débit et haute intégrité où l'exactitude et la performance sont non négociables
Bilan avéré dans la conception et la mise en production de produits basés sur l'IA de bout en bout, du concept au lancement en production
Approche pratique du développement : un·e architecte qui code encore et qui prend un réel plaisir à construire, et pas seulement à concevoir
Expérience avec des systèmes qui ingèrent et traitent de grands volumes de télémétrie provenant d'actifs physiques distribués
Familiarité avec les architectures informatiques de périphérie et les systèmes de contrôle industriels, incluant les dispositifs de périphérie et les contrôleurs de centrale (PPC)
Expérience directe dans les logiciels pour les énergies renouvelables ou le secteur énergétique au sens large (fortement souhaitée)
Solides connaissances pratiques en apprentissage automatique et en science des données, suffisantes pour prendre des décisions architecturales et de plateforme éclairées

Expérience approfondie avec GCP et/ou AWS à un niveau architectural
Expérience dans la sélection et le déploiement d'outils de développement IA qui augmentent de façon significative la productivité des équipes d'ingénierie

jobs.description:
Status:
Full-time | Active New Vacancy
Location:
Ottawa, Ontario preferred | Remote work available with periodic travel to Ottawa

About the Role

Ottawa Physiotherapy & Sports Clinic is executing a multi-site clinic integration strategy, bringing several independently owned clinics under a unified corporate framework and building the foundational infrastructure to scale over time. We are seeking a hands-on, growth-oriented Director of Finance to unify distributed clinical financial operations, deliver clear visibility on consolidated cash flow and performance to executive leadership, and partner on the execution of our corporate growth strategy.

You will spearhead the financial integration roadmap with direct support from clinic owners and the executive leadership team. This mandate requires working closely with clinic leaders to design workflows that balance local clinic realities with parent-company governance, collaborating tightly with operations management where system changes intersect with clinic workflows.

What You’ll Lead

Finance Operations and Controls: Oversee accounting, budgeting, forecasting, cash optimization, and financial reporting across all corporate entities. Standardize clinic-level workflows for payments, collections, reconciliations, and internal approvals. Manage relationships with external advisors for year-end preparation, corporate tax compliance, and regulatory reporting.
Systems Integration & Efficiency: Lead the evaluation, selection, and implementation of a shared corporate finance platforms. Oversee data migration, training, and system adoption. Identify and execute cost and time saving opportunities through centralized vendor purchasing and shared processes.
Change Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Act as a trusted financial partner to legacy clinic owners. Guide clinic teams through the cultural shift of financial centralization, ensuring clear communication regarding the purpose of new controls, governance, and standardized policies without causing friction in clinical workflows.
Financing, Acquisitions, and Growth: Partner with executive leadership to plan and model funding future growth. Build financial models, support commercial lender relationships, assess capital needs, conduct financial due diligence on M&A targets, and establish a repeatable playbook for onboarding new acquisitions into the group platform.

What You Bring

15+ years of progressive finance or accounting leadership experience, with a proven track record of managing reporting, cash flow, and financial controls across multiple locations, legal entities, or distributed operating units.
Demonstrated experience leading financial system migrations, cloud ERP implementations, or standardizing fragmented workflows into a centralized shared-services model.
Strong communication and change-management skills, with the ability to translate complex financial concepts into actionable insights for clinical owners and stakeholders, and encourage adoption of new ways of working.
A university degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related discipline (or equivalent professional experience).

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Scotiabank's Global Technology Enterprise Platforms (GTEP) provides secure, resilient and efficient technology infrastructure that enable the Bank's business strategy and customer experience. The Strategic Portfolio Office (SPO) supports GTEP leadership through integrated strategy, financial management, performance transparency, portfolio governance and enterprise-wide transformation.

The Director, Financial Performance & Efficiency
is responsible for leading the financial performance management and efficiency agenda across GTEP. The role provides an integrated view of financial results, outlook, productivity and value delivery, enabling leaders to make timely, fact-based decisions and deliver against financial commitments.

The role is accountable for strengthening planning, forecasting, performance reporting and cost governance; identifying and advancing sustainable efficiency opportunities; and translating financial and operational information into clear executive insights. This includes partnering across GTEP, Finance, Procurement and other stakeholders to improve transparency, accountability and execution.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Financial Planning & Performance Management
Lead integrated financial planning, forecasting and performance management across GTEP, aligning financial commitments with strategic priorities and delivery plans.
Establish a clear and consistent view of actuals, outlook, variances, risks and opportunities, with defined ownership and actions to close performance gaps.
Develop executive-level reporting and insights that connect financial results with operational drivers, investment choices and business outcomes.
Strengthen financial governance, management routines and decision support to improve predictability, transparency and accountability.

Efficiency & Value Optimization
Define and advance the GTEP efficiency agenda, including sustainable cost reduction, demand management, productivity improvement and reinvestment opportunities.
Identify, assess and prioritize efficiency opportunities using financial, operational and benchmark information; establish baselines, targets, benefits and delivery plans.
Track realized and forecast benefits, challenge delivery gaps and ensure efficiency commitments are supported by credible actions and evidence.
Promote disciplined cost management and value-based decision making across the organization without compromising resilience, risk management or service outcomes.

Governance, Reporting & Insights
Own the financial performance and efficiency reporting framework, including measures, definitions, data quality standards, controls and executive reporting cadence.
Provide concise, forward-looking insights and recommendations to GTEP leaders, highlighting material trends, trade-offs, decisions and required interventions.
Improve the consistency and usability of management information by simplifying reporting, reducing manual effort and enabling greater automation where appropriate.
Support leadership forums, planning cycles and portfolio reviews with decision-ready analysis and clear accountability for follow-through.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management
Build trusted partnerships with GTEP leaders, Finance, Procurement, workforce teams, portfolio owners and other enterprise stakeholders.
Influence senior stakeholders to align financial choices, operational priorities and efficiency actions with GTEP and Bank objectives.
Foster a culture of ownership, constructive challenge, collaboration, continuous improvement and measurable value delivery.
Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team with strong capabilities in financial management, analytics, business advisory and executive communication.

Skills

University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline; a professional accounting or finance designation is an asset.
10+ years of progressive experience in financial management, business performance, strategic planning, cost optimization, technology finance or a related field within a large, complex organization.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale planning, forecasting, management reporting and efficiency programs.
Strong financial acumen with the ability to connect financial results to operational drivers, strategic choices and measurable business outcomes.
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating complex data into clear executive insights and recommendations.
Experience establishing performance measures, financial governance, benefit tracking and management routines that improve accountability and execution.
Strong stakeholder management, influencing and executive communication capabilities, including the ability to constructively challenge senior leaders.
Demonstrated leadership experience building and developing high-performing teams in a matrixed enterprise environment.
Knowledge of technology infrastructure, enterprise platforms, financial services or regulated environments is an asset.

Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.

Are you a CPA with strong financial modelling expertise and a track record of driving growth through acquisitions? We're seeking a Director of Finance to join a growing Canadian technology-enabled services organization operating in the compliance, background screening, and digital identity verification space.

Reporting directly to the CEO and presenting financial insights to the Board of Directors, you'll play a pivotal role in strengthening financial governance, protecting profitability, and supporting an ambitious buy-and-build growth strategy. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity where your analytical expertise and commercial judgment will directly influence business decisions.

What's In It for You

• Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus tied to measurable financial outcomes.
• Direct exposure to executive leadership, board-level decision-making, and acquisition strategy.
• Opportunity to build scalable financial processes and shape the finance function within a growing organization.
• A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where your expertise and ideas make a tangible impact.

Your Responsibilities

• You'll lead financial reporting, budgeting, cash flow oversight, internal controls, and audit readiness, partnering closely with the Controller.
• You'll develop sophisticated financial models to evaluate pricing, profitability, acquisition opportunities, financing structures, and investment returns.
• You'll support buy-side M&A activities, including financial due diligence, EBITDA validation, acquisition valuations, and post-acquisition financial integration.
• You'll establish pricing frameworks, analyze transactional costs, and identify opportunities to protect margins and improve commercial performance.
• You'll build KPI dashboards and deliver accurate, actionable financial reporting to the CEO and Board.
• You'll oversee multi-provincial tax compliance and transition appropriate outsourced accounting activities in-house.

Skills and Qualifications

• Significant progressive experience in financial controllership and finance leadership, including hands-on financial analysis, reporting, and modelling.
• Mandatory Canadian CPA designation in good standing. A CFA designation is considered an additional asset but does not replace the CPA requirement.
• Proven buy-side M&A experience, specifically supporting growth through acquisitions and buy-and-build strategies.
• Exceptional quantitative abilities, advanced Excel proficiency, and demonstrated expertise building, validating, and challenging complex financial models.
• Financial experience within technology-enabled services, SaaS, high-volume transactional businesses, or digital affiliate networks.
• Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to translate detailed financial analysis into strategic recommendations.
• Experience developing financial controls, managing budgets, and communicating effectively with executive leadership and boards.

"We're looking for a hands-on finance leader who loves getting into the numbers, challenges assumptions, and understands how acquisitions can drive growth. Someone who can bring structure to our financial operations while helping us make smarter, more profitable decisions."

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Scotiabank's Global Technology Enterprise Platforms (GTEP) provides secure, resilient and efficient technology infrastructure that enable the Bank's business strategy and customer experience. The Strategic Portfolio Office (SPO) supports GTEP leadership through integrated strategy, financial management, performance transparency, portfolio governance and enterprise-wide transformation.

The Director, Financial Performance & Efficiency
is responsible for leading the financial performance management and efficiency agenda across GTEP. The role provides an integrated view of financial results, outlook, productivity and value delivery, enabling leaders to make timely, fact-based decisions and deliver against financial commitments.

The role is accountable for strengthening planning, forecasting, performance reporting and cost governance; identifying and advancing sustainable efficiency opportunities; and translating financial and operational information into clear executive insights. This includes partnering across GTEP, Finance, Procurement and other stakeholders to improve transparency, accountability and execution.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Financial Planning & Performance Management
Lead integrated financial planning, forecasting and performance management across GTEP, aligning financial commitments with strategic priorities and delivery plans.
Establish a clear and consistent view of actuals, outlook, variances, risks and opportunities, with defined ownership and actions to close performance gaps.
Develop executive-level reporting and insights that connect financial results with operational drivers, investment choices and business outcomes.
Strengthen financial governance, management routines and decision support to improve predictability, transparency and accountability.

Efficiency & Value Optimization
Define and advance the GTEP efficiency agenda, including sustainable cost reduction, demand management, productivity improvement and reinvestment opportunities.
Identify, assess and prioritize efficiency opportunities using financial, operational and benchmark information; establish baselines, targets, benefits and delivery plans.
Track realized and forecast benefits, challenge delivery gaps and ensure efficiency commitments are supported by credible actions and evidence.
Promote disciplined cost management and value-based decision making across the organization without compromising resilience, risk management or service outcomes.

Governance, Reporting & Insights
Own the financial performance and efficiency reporting framework, including measures, definitions, data quality standards, controls and executive reporting cadence.
Provide concise, forward-looking insights and recommendations to GTEP leaders, highlighting material trends, trade-offs, decisions and required interventions.
Improve the consistency and usability of management information by simplifying reporting, reducing manual effort and enabling greater automation where appropriate.
Support leadership forums, planning cycles and portfolio reviews with decision-ready analysis and clear accountability for follow-through.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management
Build trusted partnerships with GTEP leaders, Finance, Procurement, workforce teams, portfolio owners and other enterprise stakeholders.
Influence senior stakeholders to align financial choices, operational priorities and efficiency actions with GTEP and Bank objectives.
Foster a culture of ownership, constructive challenge, collaboration, continuous improvement and measurable value delivery.
Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team with strong capabilities in financial management, analytics, business advisory and executive communication.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:

University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline; a professional accounting or finance designation is an asset.
10+ years of progressive experience in financial management, business performance, strategic planning, cost optimization, technology finance or a related field within a large, complex organization.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale planning, forecasting, management reporting and efficiency programs.
Strong financial acumen with the ability to connect financial results to operational drivers, strategic choices and measurable business outcomes.
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating complex data into clear executive insights and recommendations.
Experience establishing performance measures, financial governance, benefit tracking and management routines that improve accountability and execution.
Strong stakeholder management, influencing and executive communication capabilities, including the ability to constructively challenge senior leaders.
Demonstrated leadership experience building and developing high-performing teams in a matrixed enterprise environment.
Knowledge of technology infrastructure, enterprise platforms, financial services or regulated environments is an asset.
